_about: Named texture patches of the Set1 vehicle atlases, read from where the original units map their faces (2026-10-28). rect = [u0, v0, u1, v1] in texture pixels (0..255). swatches.png shows every patch. Yellow/black key areas of the atlases are left out on purpose.
_donors_about: Original block (source model, block number) copied when a model has no opaque block with that texture: a texture name can only be renamed to one that is not longer, so copying is the safe route.

resistance.hull.use: light blue-grey hull plating (Falcon, Jaguar, Tiger)

resistance.hull_slot.use: hull plate with a dark slot / vent

resistance.hull_plain.use: large smooth hull or wing panel

resistance.station.use: heavy station panel (host station, flak, buildings)

ghorkov.hull_dark.use: darker mottled plating: belly, sides, big panels

ghorkov.grille.use: four black windows in a frame (fronts, turret slits)

ghorkov.vents.use: rows of small dark vents (engine decks)

taerkasten.plate.use: dark riveted iron plate (Mnosjetz, Zeppelin, Bronsteijn)

taerkasten.plate2.use: second dark plate patch (variety on big hulls)

taerkasten.window.use: dark frame with a blue glow (canopy, porthole)

taerkasten.masonry.use: stone facade with small windows (fortress walls)

taerkasten.armor.use: dark grey tank armour (Eisenhans, Leonid, Thor's Hammer)

mykonian.veins.use: dark alien cable / bio-vein lattice (every Mykonian unit)

mykonian.veins_small.use: tighter crop of the vein lattice (small faces)

sulgogar.flesh.use: olive organic flesh (Queen, Slime Lord, Mean Green)

blacksect.hull_lights.use: dark steel with rows of small lights
